grading_system.evidence: To graduate, you must demonstrate proficiency or distinction in Twinfield's twenty-eight content standards.
grading_system.proficiency_scale: Started / Progressing / Proficient / Distinguished (per 2022-23 Proficiency-based Graduation guide, catalogs/twinfield-union-school/grad_requirements_2022-23.pdf)

schedule.evidence: Course listings are marked Full Year, Fall Semester, Spring Semester, Semester 1, Semester 2, or Both semesters (Science section, page 6 of text). Number of classes taken at once is not stated.

credit_definition.text: not_stated: the 2026-27 Program of Studies gives no credit values; graduation is counted in content standards (proficiencies), not credits.
credit_definition.evidence: No credit values are stated in the 2026-27 Program of Studies text.

course_load.evidence: No course-load requirement is stated in the 2026-27 Program of Studies text.

local_grad_requirements.conversion_note: Requirement is 28 content standards (proficiency or distinction), not credits; the catalog gives no conversion to credits. Each indicator is met at least once unless marked (e.g. 4x). Also Graduation Portfolio required, and Health requires proficiency in 7 of 13 health indicators.

flexible_pathways_listed: Renaissance personalized learning experiences (internships, school-to-work, service learning, project-based, purposeful travel)
college courses at area colleges (e.g. SNHU at Danville)
cte_centers: Central Vermont Career Center (per 2022-23 Student Guide; not named in 2026-27 Program of Studies text)
notes: Graduation is by proficiency (no credit count); source for graduation statements is catalogs/twinfield-union-school/grad_requirements_2022-23.pdf (2022-23 guide, p.5), not the 2026-27 Program of Studies text, which does not contain the graduation section. Required items: Graduation Portfolio; Personalized Learning Plan updated yearly (2022-23 guide); Passage Presentations; Habits of Mind (Engagement and Responsibility) assessed; 80 hours of community service by end of senior year (honor-roll criteria, per 2022-23 guide). Probability & Statistics and Financial Literacy are required graduation indicators. 9th and 10th grade English and 9th grade Physical Science are described as required classes in the 2026-27 text. The 2026-27 text names no credit values and no graduation credit total.
